stem:
The side wall of a barn is shown with its dimensions in feet.

What is the area of the barn wall in square feet?
visual_elements: Diagram showing the side wall of a barn with dimensions in feet: A rectangle of height 11 ft and base 15 ft, topped by a trapezoid with the short parallel side 15 ft, the height 4 ft on both sides, and slant sides 3 ft each.
